intro.text: A listener who comes to Kholinar for the feast on the night of Gavilar Kholin's assassination.

items.text: At the feast in Kholinar, Gitgeth helped unload the drums and let Eshonai go off to explore the palace on her own.

appearance.text: He wears rubies in his beard, and his skin shows strong red patterns.

personality.text: Considerate, he worries about the parshmen.
